column4: DA SAAD - RFO IVA - Food Production and Livelihood Component [Special Area for Agricultural Development (SAAD)]
column6: DA - Special Area for Agricultural Development (SAAD) Phase 2
column8:
The SAAD Program Phase 2 is a locally-funded project designed to complement the DA banner programs in providing agricultural inputs related to rice, corn, high-value crops, livestock, poultry, capture fisheries, aquaculture, postharvest in the poorest and most remote areas of the country that have not received support from DA regular programs. 

The food and livelihood component also include specialized/technical training, prioritizing the poorest and most remote areas of the country that have not received support from DA/BFAR regular programs. This is achieved through the "Small Brother, Big Brother" concept, where SAAD serves as the Small Brother that prepares beneficiaries to be productive, sustainable, and attain requirements set by the other DA programs. Once the beneficiaries achieve the program's target sustainability, they shall then be endorsed as recipients of the DA regular programs (Big Brother).
